get.summary: fpp-failover: current role, state, peer health, player position, heard players and recent events

post.summary: fpp-failover: become the active player. Body {"graceful": true} waits for the peer's current item to end; false stops the peer immediately
fpp-failover: stop running the show and stand by. Body {"manual": true} pins a primary in standby until fail-back
fpp-failover: return the show to the primary player (graceful, at the end of the current item)
fpp-failover: clear the manual standby flag without forcing a takeover
fpp-failover: snapshot the current stable content, then pull the primary's content over it (backup or remote). /syncContent is an alias

409.description: Wrong role, or a content job is already running

post.summary: fpp-failover: dry run listing what a promote would change; result appears under contentSync.pending in /status
fpp-failover: restore a snapshot. Body {"snapshot": "<id>|latest", "target": "local|primary|both"}. Rolling back the primary snapshots its current content first
fpp-failover (node to node): ask the active player to finish its current item and hand the show over. Returns {accepted, playlist, nextIndex, endsInMs}
